evidence: Restaurant list shows name, cuisine, price, rating, location, features; detail page for The Golden Fork shows name, cuisine, address/location, price, description, and features (Private Dining, Wine Pairing, Tasting Menu).

Search by name (Sakura), neighborhood (Waterfront) each correctly filtered to 1 matching restaurant. Cuisine filter (Japanese) narrowed to Sakura Garden. Combining Japanese cuisine + $$ price (Sakura Garden is $$$) correctly yielded 'No restaurants found matching your criteria', proving AND combination across criteria.

Submitting with all fields empty triggers native HTML5 required-field validation focusing the Name field ('Please fill out this field.'). Submitting with name/email/phone filled but date/time missing shows a toast 'Missing Information - Please fill in all required fields.'. Submitting with an invalid email format ('not-an-email') is blocked by native email validation ('Please include an @ in the email address...'), keeping focus on the Email field and preventing submission.

Created reservation for The Golden Fork on Aug 26, 2026 at 19:00 for 2 guests with name/email/phone. Toast 'Reservation Confirmed!' appeared and reservation now shows in Upcoming (1) tab with correct restaurant, date, time, party size, location.

Date picker calendar disabled all past dates (23, 24 and earlier) while enabling today+1 onward (25, 26, 27...). Successfully selected Aug 26, 2026 (a valid future date) combined with an available time slot (19:00) from the restaurant's offered times list, and the reservation was created successfully.

issue: Coupon eligibility rules (first-reservation, day) not enforced server/client-side
actual: GROUP15 (requires party of 6+) was correctly rejected for a 2-guest reservation with message 'This coupon requires a party of 6 or more.' However: (1) WEEKEND20 ('20% off weekend dining') was accepted and applied for Aug 26, 2026, which is a Wednesday, not a weekend day - the day-of-week eligibility rule was not enforced. (2) After already completing one reservation with WELCOME10 applied (a 'first reservation' coupon), WELCOME10 was successfully applied again on a second, different restaurant's reservation form, showing 'Coupon Applied! 10% off your first reservation' even though this was no longer the user's first reservation - the first-reservation eligibility rule was not enforced. Only the party-size rule and the 'max one coupon per reservation' constraint (verified via UI replacing the input with a single applied-coupon badge) worked correctly.

issue: Modify reservation dialog does not support changing the date
actual: Opening 'Modify' on an upcoming reservation shows a dialog with only 'New Time' and 'Party Size' fields; there is no date field. Time was changed 13:00→19:00 and Party Size 2→4 Guests, saved successfully and reflected in the list (toast 'Reservation Updated'), but the reservation's date (Aug 27, 2026) could not be changed at all through this UI, violating the requirement to change date, time, and party size.

evidence: Cancelled the Sakura Garden upcoming reservation after confirming in a dialog. It immediately disappeared from Upcoming (count dropped 2→1) and appeared in Past tab with status 'Cancelled' and all original details (date, time, party size, location) retained.

Clicking Modify opened a dialog with editable Time and Party Size fields; Save Changes persisted the update immediately. Clicking Cancel opened an alertdialog 'Cancel Reservation?' requiring explicit 'Cancel Reservation' confirmation (with a 'Keep Reservation' escape option) before the cancellation took effect.

Creating a reservation showed an immediate 'Reservation Confirmed!' toast and confirmation screen, then appeared in Upcoming list without reload. Modifying showed 'Reservation Updated' toast with list values changing immediately. Cancelling showed 'Reservation Cancelled' toast, immediately moving the item from Upcoming to Past with Cancelled status, all within the same session without manual reload.

Upcoming and Past tabs clearly separate reservations by status label ('Upcoming' vs 'Cancelled'). Each reservation card displays restaurant name/cuisine/price, date, time, party size, status badge, location (neighborhood), and applied coupon when present (e.g., 'Coupon applied: WELCOME10' shown only on the reservation where a coupon was applied).

During reservation creation, applying WELCOME10 showed a toast 'Coupon Applied! 10% off your first reservation' and replaced the coupon input with a badge 'WELCOME10 - 10% off'; clicking the X removed it, restoring the input. Re-applying and submitting resulted in the reservation list showing 'Coupon applied: WELCOME10' on that specific reservation, confirming the applied coupon is recorded with the resulting reservation.

issue: Review submission has no eligibility restriction tied to completed reservations
actual: Submitted a review for The Golden Fork despite having no completed reservation there (only an 'Upcoming' reservation existed at the time of first review submission) - it was accepted immediately ('Review Submitted!'). Then submitted a second review for the same restaurant with a different name and it was accepted again without any error, block, or limit, taking the review count from 3 to 4. This shows no restriction exists requiring a completed reservation to review, and no limit of one review per completed reservation.

evidence: Submitted a review with 5-star rating, visit date (2026-08-20), name (QA Tester), and written text via the 'Write a Review' tab. Toast 'Review Submitted!' appeared, and the review immediately appeared in the Reviews list for The Golden Fork with correct star count, name, date, and text; it was not shown on other restaurants' pages.

issue: Restaurant list rating/count not synced with detail page or review submissions
actual: The Golden Fork detail page initially showed rating 4.5 (2 reviews) computed from actual reviews, while the restaurant list page showed a different, static rating of 4.8 for the same restaurant - inconsistent from the start. After submitting two new reviews, the detail page rating updated correctly (4.5→4.7→4.0, review count 2→3→4), but the restaurant list page continued to display the original static '4.8' and did not reflect the new review count or updated average at all.
